title: Risk Technology Provider RUBIK Expands to Automated Decision-Making for Prop Firms
summary: Prop firm risk management technology vendor RUBIK announced that its platform now executes automated risk decisions for proprietary trading clients rather than solely offering advisory analytics. The capability allows prop firms to automatically manage account breaches, leverage restrictions, and toxic trading activity.
body: Risk technology vendor RUBIK has expanded its suite of services for proprietary trading firms, moving from risk monitoring and advisory alerts to automated decision-making execution. The technology provider stated that its system now takes direct risk actions on behalf of prop firm operators based on pre-set compliance parameters. Under the expanded framework, RUBIK's infrastructure can automatically flag rule violations, freeze accounts exceeding drawdown thresholds, and identify latency arbitrage or toxic trading behaviors without requiring manual operator intervention. The transition toward autonomous risk decision-making highlights how prop firms are increasingly relying on third-party technology providers to enforce challenge rules, safeguard firm capital, and manage real-time risk exposure across thousands of active accounts.
